content.short: Layerswap simplifies moving crypto from centralized exchanges directly to TON and other Layer 2 networks.
content.description: Layerswap is an innovative solution designed to simplify the process of transferring digital assets from centralized exchanges (CEXs) directly to decentralized networks like TON. It bypasses the traditional, often complex and expensive, manual withdrawal process by providing a direct and efficient path for users to move their funds. Supporting major exchanges and numerous blockchains, Layerswap is an essential tool for users looking to quickly and easily onboard into the TON ecosystem from their CEX accounts.
content.meta: Move crypto from CEXs to TON easily with Layerswap. Fast onboarding and low fees, featured on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
